title: What is the normal range for heart rate?

messages.content: What is the normal range for heart rate?

The normal resting heart rate for adults ranges from 60 to 100 beats per minute (bpm). However, athletes or individuals who are physically fit often have a lower resting heart rate, sometimes below 60 bpm. It's important to note that individual variability exists, and what is considered normal can vary based on factors such as age, sex, fitness level, and overall health.

Source: American Heart Association (2021). Normal Heart Rate. Retrieved from https://www.heart.org/en/health-topics/heart-rate-and-rhythm-issues/normal-heart-rate
